gloss: one dish, one item; fine article

definitions.gloss: one dish, one item, a single dish
definitions.explanation: A single item or dish, often referring to side dishes or additional items.
An item of exceptional quality or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {一品|いっぴん}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I order an à la carte dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一品|いっぴん}⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一品|いっぴん}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: a dish ordered on its own, à la carte; also a simple single dish
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一品|いっぴん} / あと{一品|いっぴん}: one more dish
- {一品|いっぴん}⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧: adding one more dish

WRITING:
Sense 2, a fine article or superb piece of work, is usually written ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ ({逸|いつ}, "excel"): ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧ (a hidden gem). {一品|いっぴん} in that sense survives mainly in set phrases such as ⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧{一品|いっぴん} (the finest in the land).
